messages.en: I've watched that documentary. That queen reigned for quite a long time, didn't she?
Yeah, over forty years. I want to watch the next episode tonight.
Traffic's already backed up here, so I'll be a bit late, okay?
No worries, drive safely. I'll just wait at the shop.
Re on the periodic table stands for rhenium, right?
Yep, rhenium. I checked—its atomic number is 75.
Is our break over already? I'm still at the canteen.
Not yet, but there's only five minutes left. We can head upstairs together after that.
